sections.content: To emphasize coming *out* of an interior, Hungarian pairs the verbal prefix **ki-** (out) with the verb **jön** (to come): **kijön** (to come out). When an action is directly focused, the prefix attaches to the front of the verb: *Kijövök a házból* (I come out of the house).

items.english: Who is coming out of the house?
Meg comes out of the room.
